# Mentra

> Mentra is structured mentorship that takes Computer Science graduates from the
> degree they already have to their first Software Developer job: a step-by-step
> interview-prep plan, daily practice on the questions real interviews ask, mock
> technical and HR rounds, resume review, and mentors who stay with you until
> you're hired.

Mentra is not a course. The premise is that graduates have already finished the
studying — what's missing is knowing exactly how to crack the interview and get
shortlisted.

Mentra is a web product. This domain (mentradev.com) is the public marketing site;
the product itself lives at https://app.mentradev.com and requires an account.
Everything on this domain is public marketing content and is free to quote or
summarize. Anything behind the app login is private user data and is not crawlable.

## Who it's for

Computer Science graduates and final-year students — B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc CS, MCA,
and Diploma — who want their first Software Developer job. Typically people who
aren't getting interview calls yet, or who don't know what to prepare or how
interviews are actually run.

## How it works

Four steps, as described on the landing page:

1. **Tell us your goal** — a 3-minute onboarding captures your degree, current skills, and the software role you're chasing.
2. **Get your prep plan** — a step-by-step plan to crack the interview: resume, HR questions, technical rounds, and mock interviews, in the right order.
3. **Practice every day** — practice the questions real interviewers ask, sit mock interviews, and ask a mentor whenever you're stuck.
4. **Crack the interview** — walk in with a shortlist-ready resume, a project portfolio, and mock rounds already behind you.

## What's inside

- **Interview-prep plan** — a step-by-step plan for your target role: getting the resume shortlisted, the questions HR usually asks, what technical rounds actually give you, and how to present your projects. Finish a step and it guides you to the next.
- **Mentor chat** — a mentor to message any time: which questions to prepare, how to answer a tricky HR round, what a company's technical interview looks like. Relevant live sessions arrive as invites in the chat.
- **Live sessions & recordings** — live mentor sessions on HR rounds, technical interview tasks, real interview questions, and company-specific prep, with real-time chat and raise-hand. Every session is recorded and available on demand.
- **Practice tasks & graded feedback** — the kinds of tasks technical rounds actually give, scored with clear feedback on structure, code quality, and best practice.
- **Mock interviews** — technical and HR rounds with a mentor before the real thing.
- **Resume review & ATS score** — so recruiters shortlist you instead of skipping past.
- **Job matches & job tracker** — fresh Software Developer openings matched to your profile, with every application and interview round tracked in one place.
- **Progress tracking** — streaks, an activity heatmap, performance analytics, and a "where to focus" read that tells you what to prepare next.
- **Community & contests** — public profiles, leaderboards, and coding contests alongside people chasing the same goal.
- **Real mentors** — 1:1 bookings with mentors who have cleared these interviews.

## Plans

- **Starter (free)** — personalized interview-prep plan, daily interview practice and real questions, progress tracking and streaks. No credit card required.
- **Pro** — everything in Starter, plus live sessions and mock interviews, mentor bookings, resume review, and job matches.

## Key facts

- Mentra is mentorship and interview preparation, not another course or certificate.
- Built around interview outcomes: practice, mock rounds, resume shortlisting, and applications tracked through to an offer.
- The always-on chat mentor is AI. Live sessions, mock interviews, and bookings connect you with real human mentors.
- Onboarding takes under 3 minutes and is free to start.
- Refund policy: paid plans can be refunded in full if requested within 7 calendar days of payment; refunds go back to the original payment method and are usually credited in 5–7 working days. Renewals carry the same 7-day window. Details: https://mentradev.com/#refund
